case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C09988 reported that they never made the $59.67 online purchase (transaction 3534820) on their Visa debit card. The strongest findings are that 13 other cards made online purchases of the same amount and product C within 1 % of $59.67 using a hotmail.com email address, and seven of those cards share the same time-delta feature D15 = 21, indicating a single actor behind multiple cards; additionally, every similar customer-reported alert in the bank's closed cases was confirmed as fraud. The case was judged to be fraud with a probability of 95 %. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a new case, file a report, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C09988, card C09988-K1, issued as a visa debit. On 2016-12-11, 1 transaction(s) totalling $59.67 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3534820. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, from device profile(s) Windows |  | edge 16.0 | . The transactions were online purchases inconsistent with the cardholder. The activity is assessed as card-not-present fraud from a device new to the account: 13 other cards made online C purchases within 1% of $59.67 with P email hotmail.com within 7 days, and 7 of them share this transaction's time-delta feature D15 = 21, which points to one actor behind several card numbers; Customer C09988 disputes transaction 3534820 ($59.67); in the bank's closed cases every customer-reported alert was confirmed fraud. The same a fixed-amount purchase template ($59.67, product C, email hotmail.com, time-delta feature D15 = 21) links this activity to 7 other card(s), including C00854-K2, C03047-K2, C05630-K1, C05793-K1, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-5541, CC-4879, CC-2103 show the same pattern. The cardholder reported the disputed transaction to the bank and denied making it. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R6, §3a.
